title: The server asks Hyprland for key repeat that the host already sends the viewer
body:
`Hyprland::option` in `hypr.rs` has one caller, `compositor::run`, which reads `input:repeat_delay` and `input:repeat_rate`. The viewer receives `wl_keyboard.repeat_info` from its host on any compositor.

## Proposal

Forward the repeat info over the viewer protocol and drop `option`, so key repeat no longer depends on Hyprland. A protocol change, which moves both crates' versions.
close_reason: Landed in 216bc85. The viewer sends repeat(rate, delay) after welcome and on every repeat_info. The server applies the newest one with change_repeat_info, and Hyprland::option is gone. The viewer protocol is not decade-channel's, so only decade's changelog changed: the unreleased entry on key repeat now names the host compositor.
